ranking: agreed best first, then chance to hit
note: Run by hand at 3 PM ET (the 1 PM scheduled run did not start because the computer was offline). 10 games left after the early games (FLA-WSH, STL-NSH). San Jose and Minnesota are on the 2nd night of a back-to-back (allowed now; the model lowers them a bit). Agreed = in all three agents' top 4: Detroit +2.5 and Seattle +1.5 (agreed best, not guaranteed; both have big model-market gaps). Agents 2 and 3 also both picked NY Islanders +1.5 and Ottawa +1.5. LESSONS APPLIED from the Nov 6 review: (1) every game now adjusts for the starting goalies (regressed save %), and player points props for the opponent's expected goals; (2) Weegar and DeAngelo points unders were removed because their power-play time just jumped (both now on PP2); (3) Kucherov and Johnston points unders were removed because they face back-to-back teams; (4) points-under estimates are capped at the market when the model is 10+ points higher. Goalies: Korpisalo (NYR, season debut, confirmed), Daccord/Grubauer (SEA, unconfirmed), Fowler-Bobrovsky, Allen-Sorokin, Vejmelka-Ersson, Knight-Kochetkov, Hildeby-Pickard (both backups), Nedeljkovic-Oettinger, Tarasov-Blackwood (Gibson injured), Murashov-Kuemper, Merilainen-Levi. Lineups and power-play units checked on RotoWire; injuries from NHL.com previews. Estimate = midpoint of Pinnacle no-vig and Agent 1's model; the model has no empty-net effect. Excluded: goals props and assists unders (Steve's rules), anything shorter than -300, whole-number totals. Pinnacle prices re-checked 3:16 PM ET (Seattle +1.5 -218 to -222). bet365 (read only): Tampa-Minnesota under 7.5 is slightly better there (-260); Pinnacle better on everything else.
